The Petitioner has filed the present Petition under Section 17 of the Act seeking approval for the creation of security interest over its movable and immovable assets in favour of Respondent No. 1, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (hereinafter referred to as the "Security Trustee"), acting for and on behalf of and for the benefit of Respondent No. 2 i.e., Aseem Infrastructure Finance Limited (hereinafter referred to as the "Lender"), including their subsequent transferees, assigns, novatees and any refinancing lenders to the Project, pursuant to the Security Trustee Agreement, Facility Agreement, and other financing documents executed in connection with the Project. 18. The Petitioner and the Lender, have appointed Catalyst Trusteeship Limited as the Security Trustee for the creation of a Security Interest over all the movable and immovable assets of the Project. In our view, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited needs to be given comfort that security will be created for the benefit of the Lender, as security for the financial assistance provided by them. We, therefore, accord approval allowing the Petitioner to create a Security Interest in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, acting as the Security Trustee for and on behalf of the lender, including their subsequent transferees, assigns, novatees and any refinancing lenders to the Project, by way of mortgage or any other security document over the Project assets through execution of the Indenture of Mortgage and other financing documents relating to the Project. The Petitioner is directed to submit a signed copy of the Indenture of Mortgage for the Project immediately after its execution.
